name: greenhouse-mcp
description: Recruiting workflow tools for Greenhouse ATS (candidate screening, applications, pipeline search, resume scanning) inside Claude.
long_description: Curated Greenhouse recruiting tools for Claude: candidate screening, application triage, pipeline search, and resume scanning. Resumes are extracted to text server-side (PDF and DOCX) and candidate location is detected from several signals. The tool set is fixed to the recruiter-safe curated profile. Uses the Harvest v3 API, which needs a client ID and secret from your Greenhouse admin — the old personal Harvest API keys stopped working after 2026-08-31.

greenhouse_client_id.title: Greenhouse Client ID
greenhouse_client_id.description: The Harvest v3 client ID issued by your Greenhouse admin (Configure → Dev Center → API Credential Management), with scopes granted for the endpoints you need.

greenhouse_client_secret.title: Greenhouse Client Secret
greenhouse_client_secret.description: The secret paired with the client ID above. Treat it like a password: it is shown once at creation and cannot be read back.

greenhouse_user_id.title: Your Greenhouse User ID
greenhouse_user_id.description: Your own Greenhouse user ID. Harvest v3 attributes each call to this user, so set it to yourself rather than a shared account.

greenhouse_board_token.title: Greenhouse Job Board Token
greenhouse_board_token.description: Your Greenhouse Job Board URL token, for read-only public job board tools. Optional.

on_behalf_of.title: On-Behalf-Of User ID
on_behalf_of.description: Optional Greenhouse user ID to attribute write actions to, for audit trail purposes.

log_level.title: Log Level
log_level.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warning, or error.
